i.norm: Verifies that {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#removeAccents(String)} strips the diacritics from a mix of German, Spanish and French accented letters, replacing each with its plain ASCII equivalent while preserving the original letter case.

Each accented character maps to its plain ASCII letter (case preserved), while the German "ß" has no ASCII equivalent and is therefore left unchanged: ä->a ë->e ö->o ü->u ß->ß Ä->A Ë->E Ö->O Ü->U ñ->n Ñ->N à->a
